name: business
summary: New /suggest-metrics command — recommends the decision-driving KPIs a domain's dashboard should show (answers 'I want to add stats but don't know which'). Detects the domain, inventories the metrics already displayed, diffs against the domain decision-metric set across six coverage categories (acquisition/conversion/revenue/retention/ops/product), and recommends the missing high-value ones — each gated on being decision-linked, computable (from existing data or a named instrumentation gap), and non-duplicate. It is the metrics arm of the business-completeness rule; recommends WHICH + HOW to compute and hands off (does not build tiles/queries). Guards against metric-theater: no vanity metrics, no uncomputable hand-waving, rate>count where the rate is the signal.

domain-model-auditor: invariant edge-rejection proof; workflow-integrity: money-conservation probe (full reversal restores exact charged cents) on money-moving edges.

NEW command /suggest-metrics (business pack) — domain-aware dashboard-KPI coverage: detect domain -> inventory shown metrics -> diff vs the six-category decision-metric set -> recommend missing high-value metrics prioritized by decision-leverage x computability, with closure verbs recommend-metric / upgrade-count-to-rate / pair-metric / flag-vanity / name-missing-instrumentation. Every recommendation carries a decision, a formula, and a data source (have-data / needs-instrumentation) or it is dropped.
